name: XR Hardware Checkup
summary:
**XR Hardware Check** is an all-in-one diagnostic utility designed for Meta Quest headsets.

Quickly inspect common headset functions through a clean, desktop-style interface. Test speaker channels, display colours, pixel patterns and pointer accuracy while viewing live device information such as battery level, thermal status, memory, storage and refresh rate.

**Included features**
- Left, right and stereo speaker tests
- Low, mid and high-frequency audio tests
- Frequency sweep and alternating stereo ping
